The split is done in `SettingValueConversions.TryParseStaticMemberAccessor`. I located the regex and the call site but didn't read the body of `TryParseStaticMemberAccessor`, so I haven't confirmed how it uses the match groups.

- **Regex:** the `StaticMemberAccessorRegex` field at `src/Serilog/Settings/KeyValuePairs/SettingValueConversions.cs:22` is `^(?<shortTypeName>[^:]+)::(?<memberName>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*)(?<typeNameExtraQualifiers>[^:]*)$`. It captures the type name before `::`, the member name after it, and any trailing assembly qualifiers.
- **Call site:** the conversion method at line 66 calls `TryParseStaticMemberAccessor(value, out var accessorTypeName, out var memberName)`. It then looks up a public static property or field with that member name on the resolved type.
